rationale: The assistant correctly identified the behaviour as the normal cooling fan running on until the oven cools, matching the hidden truth, and gave a sensible boundary ('still running after an hour or so, or if it never stops even when the oven is completely cold') for when it would be a fault. It used only the customer's stated evidence, invented nothing, and recommended no parts or DIY. It did not ask a confirming question (e.g. whether it has ever run for hours or any burning smell) or point to the manual or manufacturer explicitly, and the one-line answer opens with 'No, it is not broken' before caveats, but overall a UK homeowner would be well served.
